name: Holographic Card
description: Image cards that tilt in 3D toward the pointer with a shifting holographic foil glow, dot pattern, and a soft light shine following the cursor.
contents: Row of image cards with a holographic glow layer and a shine layer
behavior: Card tilts in 3D following the pointer position
Image shifts slightly opposite the tilt for depth
Foil gradient and dot pattern move with the pointer and brighten on hover
Card eases back to center when the pointer leaves
editableByProps: Number of cards, images and alt text
Card size, aspect ratio and corner radius
Tilt strength, image parallax and zoom
Glow colors, glow and shine intensity, dot pattern size
Background as a Tailwind background class

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the foil gradient angle or stops
needsCodeEdit.where: background-image gradient in the first aria-hidden div

fixed: Root fills at least the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !min-h-0.
Tilt and glow respond to pointer movement only, touch drag moves them while touching
